segments.text: 感謝天恩師德，感謝上方慈悲，讓後學有機會來跟各位分享報告這一堂課，修道保險單。修道保險單。人間有保險。修道的保險是什麼。各位前賢。我們人世間都有保險。為什麼我們要買保險。我們買一個保障。因為萬一發生事情的時候，
segments.source_en: Grateful for Heaven's grace and the mercy of the divine, which allows me the opportunity to share this lesson with you all: The Cultivation Insurance Policy. There is insurance in the human world, but what is the insurance for spiritual cultivation? Fellow practitioners, we all have insurance in the human world; why do we buy it?
segments.en_text: Grateful for Heaven's grace and the mercy of the divine, which allows me the opportunity to share this lesson with you all: The Cultivation Insurance Policy. There is insurance in the human world, but what is the insurance for spiritual cultivation? Fellow practitioners, we all have insurance in the human world; why do we buy it?

segments.text: 因為我們有買保險多了一份保障。才不會讓我們發生事情的時候，措手不及。我們都知道人間的保險有很多。有產險。有壽險。還有旅遊平安險。有很多很多的保險。
segments.source_en: We buy it for protection, so that if something happens, having that insurance ensures we are not caught off guard. We know there are many types of insurance in the human world: disability insurance, life insurance, travel insurance, and many, many more.
segments.en_text: We buy it for protection, so that if something happens, having that insurance ensures we are not caught off guard. We know there are many types of insurance in the human world: disability insurance, life insurance, travel insurance, and many, many more.

segments.text: 那這些保險當中都是讓我們。不管是產險針對我們的不動產險或是我們汽車的動產這些，它在保這些當中，能夠因為我們有保險。我們在做事情的時候我們比較放心。我們買了壽險。買了醫療險。買了儲蓄險。我們有這些人間的這些保險當中。在我們未來的時候。面對醫療的時候。因為有買醫療險。我們就不用擔心未來有疾病的時候，
segments.source_en: These policies protect our real estate or movable assets like cars, giving us peace of mind when we go about our daily lives. We buy life insurance, health insurance, and savings plans so that when we face medical needs in the future, we don't have to worry about where to find the funds for large expenses.
segments.en_text: These policies protect our real estate or movable assets like cars, giving us peace of mind when we go about our daily lives. We buy life insurance, health insurance, and savings plans so that when we face medical needs in the future, we don't have to worry about where to find the funds for large expenses.

segments.text: 我們需要龐大的經費怎麼辦。因為你有買保險。所以保險是讓我們得到保障。很重要。那麼人世間都有保險，人間有保險。那各位前賢。我們來探討一下。那我們修道到底有沒有保險呢。
segments.source_en: Because you have insurance, it provides us with protection; it is very important. Since there is insurance in the human world, let us explore: does our cultivation have it too? Humanity?
segments.en_text: Because you have insurance, it provides us with protection; it is very important. Since there is insurance in the human world, let us explore: does our cultivation have it too? Humanity?

segments.text: 人世間的一切。只不過我們現在所知道的人間的歷史，人世間的歷史，以我們中華文化來講，五千年的歷史。我們在西方。不管是羅馬帝國、希臘。他們有些也是幾千年的歷史。那麼在幾千年之前。
segments.source_en: Everything in this world is just part of the human history that we currently know. Taking our Chinese culture as an example, there is 5,000 years of history; in the West, the Roman Empire and Greece also have thousands of years of history.

segments.text: 宇宙確實存在。我們也知道，我們地球混沌已經好幾次了。那人間有保險，請問一下，代表修道是亙古至今都存在的事情。那它也一定有保險，那它的保險到底是什麼呢？
segments.source_en: And thousands of years before that, the universe surely existed. We also know that our Earth has gone through chaos and renewal many times. So, if there is insurance in the human world, it implies that spiritual cultivation has existed since ancient times. Then it must surely have insurance as well.

So, if there is insurance in the human world, it implies that spiritual cultivation has existed since ancient times. Then it must surely have insurance as well.

segments.text: 我們這一次就利用這堂課，我們來探討一下，修道的保險是什麼。我們回到本文裡面來探討。一、明理之後，保你歡喜自在。各顯了，原來這個保險就是這樣。第一個，當你修道，你明理之後。
segments.source_en: So, what exactly is its insurance? In this lesson, we will take the time to explore what this insurance for cultivation is. Let us return to the text to explore this. After receiving the rituals, you are guaranteed joy and freedom. Fellow practitioners. So, this is what the insurance is.

segments.text: 仙佛保證你，保障你。一定會歡喜自在。前賢，這是仙佛應允我們。答應我們。給我們的承諾。假設你明理之後，你一定可以歡喜自在。那現在我們來檢視一下。
segments.source_en: First, when you cultivate and receive the rituals, the enlightened beings guarantee that you will be joyful and at ease. Fellow practitioners, this is the promise that the enlightened beings have granted us. Assuming you have, you will surely be joyful and at ease.
segments.en_text: First, when you cultivate and receive the rituals, the enlightened beings guarantee that you will be joyful and at ease. Fellow practitioners, this is the promise that the enlightened beings have granted us. Assuming you have, you will surely be joyful and at ease.

segments.text: 你修道的這個保單，到底還有沒有效。我們人間的保單，你有空也要去檢視看看。有沒有合乎你現在的這個狀況。那我們修道來講，我們也檢視一下。仙佛說：「明理之後，保你歡喜自在。」那我們來檢視看看。
segments.source_en: Now, let us explain whether this cultivation insurance policy of yours is still valid. Just as we should occasionally review our worldly insurance policies to see if they still suit our current situation. As for our cultivation, let us examine it as well. The Immortals state that after understanding the Truth, you are guaranteed joy and freedom.
segments.en_text: Now, let us explain whether this cultivation insurance policy of yours is still valid. Just as we should occasionally review our worldly insurance policies to see if they still suit our current situation. As for our cultivation, let us examine it as well. segments.text: 前賢。你現在是不是有歡喜自在呢。假設你有歡喜自在。那你遇到問題困難挫折。你絕對不會放在心上。你如果遇到問題困難挫折放在心上。你就代表沒有歡喜自在啦。對不對。你就可能會有疙瘩啊。
segments.source_en: So, let us examine ourselves: are you feeling joyful and free right now? If you are truly joyful and free, you will certainly not take problems, difficulties, or setbacks to heart. If you do take these things to heart, it means you lack that joy and freedom. Isn't that right?
segments.en_text: So, let us examine ourselves: are you feeling joyful and free right now? If you are truly joyful and free, you will certainly not take problems, difficulties, or setbacks to heart. If you do take these things to heart, it means you lack that joy and freedom. Isn't that right?

segments.text: 那假設你是歡喜自在。恭喜你啊。你這張保單有效。這張保單還是在效期之內。沒有超過這個期限。為什麼。因為你明理之後。保你歡喜自在。淺顯。我們把仙佛的保單。
segments.source_en: You might be harboring some knots in your mind. If you are indeed joyful and free. Congratulations, your policy is in effect. This policy is still within its valid term. It hasn't expired. Why? Because after understanding the Truth, you are guaranteed joy and freedom, fellow practitioners.

segments.text: 修道的保單。我們拿來檢視看看。隨時隨地檢視看看。我們有沒有歡喜自在。若有，代表你是明理的；若沒有，代表你對理還不是很清楚。當你清楚的時候，你一定是歡喜自在。
segments.source_en: Let us take the Immortals 'policy—the cultivation policy—and examine it. Check at any time and any place: do we have joy and freedom? If so, it means you understand the Truth; if not, it means you are not yet clear about the Truth. When you are clear, you will definitely be joyful and free.
segments.en_text: Let us take the Immortals 'policy—the cultivation policy—and examine it. Check at any time and any place: do we have joy and freedom? segments.text: 就如同彌勒祖師一樣。這個彌勒祖師笑口常開，笑開天下古今愁啊。他非常的歡喜自在。因為他是佛。他明理了。他了解。也就是當事情發生的時候。為什麼有這件事情發生？一定有它的前因跟後果。
segments.source_en: Just like Patriarch Maitreya. Oh, Patriarch Maitreya is always smiling, dissolving all the worries of the world. He is extremely joyful and free. Because he is a Buddha. He understands the Truth. He understands that when things happen, why do they happen? There must be causes and consequences.
segments.en_text: Just like Patriarch Maitreya. Oh, Patriarch Maitreya is always smiling, dissolving all the worries of the world. He is extremely joyful and free. Because he is a Buddha. segments.text: 當你了解，你清楚了，你就不會受到影響。你就可以歡喜自在。當你不明理，你就會不自在。所以歌詞寫：先檢視一下。你修道的保險單有沒有效。有沒有明理，就看你心裡有沒有歡喜自在。
segments.source_en: When you understand and are clear, you will not be affected. You can be joyful and free. When you do not understand the Truth, you will not be at ease. Therefore, fellow practitioners, examine whether your cultivation policy is effective and whether you understand the Truth. Just look at whether you are joyful and free right now.

segments.text: 我們再回到本文裡面來探討：二，茹素之後，保你健康快樂。這是寫。你身體健康嗎。像我茹素幾十年了。所以我。這個捐血。捐血。這個有一些國家叫獻血。
segments.source_en: Let us return to the text to explore further. Second: After becoming vegetarian, you are guaranteed health and happiness. Dear fellow practitioners. Are you in good health? segments.source_en: " Some countries call it "donating blood. " I have donated blood. I used to donate whole blood. After donating over 100 times. Now I donate platelets. In total, I have donated 1,202 times to this day, which shows that I am very healthy.
segments.en_text: " Some countries call it "donating blood. " I have donated blood. I used to donate whole blood. After donating over 100 times. Now I donate platelets. In total, I have donated 1,202 times to this day, which shows that I am very healthy.

segments.text: 為什麼。因為後學茹素很久了。那不只自己茹素。我全家都茹素。孩子也是胎裡素。所以仙佛告訴我們。修道的保險單的第二章。它告訴我們。茹素之後保你健康快樂。所以各位前賢，在電視機前、在螢幕前面的前賢。
segments.source_en: Why? Because I have been vegetarian for a long time. Not only myself, but my whole family is vegetarian. My children were vegetarians from birth. So the Immortals tell us, the second chapter of the cultivation policy tells us that after becoming vegetarian, you are guaranteed health and happiness.

So the Immortals tell us, the second chapter of the cultivation policy tells us that after becoming vegetarian, you are guaranteed health and happiness.

segments.text: 你茹素了嗎。假設你茹素了，你一定會健康快樂。假設你覺得說，你這個身體還不是很，這個不是很好。那，何謂茹素？為什麼要茹素？各位前賢。
segments.source_en: So, fellow practitioners in front of the TV , in front of the screen, are you vegetarian? If you are, you will definitely be healthy and happy. If you feel that your health is not quite good , then why not become vegetarian? Why should one be vegetarian?
segments.en_text: So, fellow practitioners in front of the TV , in front of the screen, are you vegetarian? If you are, you will definitely be healthy and happy. If you feel that your health is not quite good , then why not become vegetarian? Why should one be vegetarian?

segments.text: 茹素是跟眾生斷除惡緣。我們茹素的人是跟眾生不再結惡緣。各位前賢要記得。我們所吃的這些肉類。肉類，不管你是吃哪一種這個動物的肉類。畢竟，他們在我們一般的說詞。
segments.source_en: Dear seniors, vegetarianism is about severing bad ties with living beings; when we eat vegetarian, we no longer create negative karma with them. Seniors, please remember, the meat we eat— regardless of which animal it comes from—after all, in common parlance, those animals are called "beasts," right?
segments.en_text: Dear seniors, vegetarianism is about severing bad ties with living beings; when we eat vegetarian, we no longer create negative karma with them. segments.source_en: They are called beasts, so what is a beast? Sometimes when people argue , they might curse others by saying, " Are you a beast? " Especially when seeing someone acting unreasonably. Oh, when things are unreasonable, people will call others beasts. So we see that the atmosphere in today’s society is quite chaotic.

segments.source_en: There are many people whose behaviors——and actions make us feel that no normal person would ever do such things. segments.source_en: If you eat a piece of their meat today, or eat half a jin or eight ounces, you are eating a piece of meat from a beast! But eating that piece of meat doesn't necessarily provide any direct benefit to your health.

segments.text: 真的。吃太飽也苦。吃不飽也苦。太冷也苦，太熱也苦，真的是。人生有太多的苦。所以人生有八苦。生老病死，求不得，愛別離，怨憎會，五陰熾盛。我們人生有很多很多很多的苦啊。這麼多苦當中。
segments.source_en: Life is truly a sea of suffering. It really is. Being too full is suffering. Being hungry is also suffering. Birth, old age, sickness, death, and not getting what one seeks or loves. Desire for material things. The suffering of meeting those we dislike.

segments.text: 你要如何離苦得樂呢。仙佛慈悲告訴我們。有一張保單可以讓你離苦得樂。就是轉識成智。前賢。智慧要開。我們求道的當下就是幫你開智慧了。

segments.text: 讓你智慧開了。你智慧有沒有真的開了之後好好去運用呢。所以道。我們得了道之後是讓我們用的。前賢。道不是讓你保守起來放在口袋裡面。不是。道是拿來用的。當你在用當中會讓你轉識成智。自然你就能夠離苦得樂。
segments.source_en: But once your wisdom has opened , have you truly opened it enough to make good use of it? So, the Dao, once we have received it, is meant for us to apply. As you apply it, it will allow you to turn consciousness into wisdom, and naturally, you will be able to leave suffering and attain joy.

segments.text: 所以各位前賢。當你把道拿來運用當中，遇到問題困難挫折的時候。你自然可以迎刃而解。所向披靡。好比拿著一把非常鋒利的鋼刀。遇到任何事情都可以削鐵如泥。
segments.source_en: So, fellow practitioners, when you put the Dao into practice, you will naturally be able to resolve problems, difficulties, and setbacks with ease. It is just like holding a very sharp steel blade; you can cut through anything with ease when you encounter obstacles.
segments.en_text: So, fellow practitioners, when you put the Dao into practice, you will naturally be able to resolve problems, difficulties, and setbacks with ease. It is just like holding a very sharp steel blade; you can cut through anything with ease when you encounter obstacles.

segments.text: 以前這把寶刀在砍鐵的時候。如同在砍泥土一樣，非常簡單。為什麼？因為你已經轉識成智。把你的智慧劍拿出來。自然而然面對問題困難挫折的時候。你可以迎刃而解。自然就可以轉苦得樂。
segments.source_en: In the past, this precious blade could cut through iron as if it were mud. Why is it so simple? Because you have already transformed your consciousness into wisdom. segments.source_en: We just mentioned the insurance policies of practicing the Dao, and we brought up several; let us examine them, and now that we have, let us study how we can truly be happy and joyful. So, how can you obtain happiness, health, and joy? How should you walk this path?

segments.text: 因為我們心念沒有掌握住，有偏差，你自然就不健康、不幸福、不美滿，你就沒辦法過幸福快樂的生活。你自然就沒有辦法幸福健康快樂的走。你就有很多的憂愁。想像一下。

segments.en_text: At the moment we face death, everything must be relinquished; as the saying goes, " You cannot take anything with you, only your karma follows you. " There is nothing you can take with you; everything must be left behind. If you aren't used to letting go, then let me ask you, when that day finally arrives, what will you do?

segments.text: 你糾結在那邊，反而更麻煩。所以各位前賢，很重要哦。我們再回到本題裡面繼續來探討。像現在非常流行整形。每個人只懂得自我外表的改造。卻不懂得往心去改造。調整、修正。而要真正自我改造，得從內心著手，各位前賢。
segments.source_en: Oh, you will be tangled up in it, which only makes things more troublesome. So everyone, this is very important; let us return to the main point and continue our discussion. Nowadays, plastic surgery is very popular; everyone only knows how to transform their outward appearance but doesn't know how to cultivate and adjust their hearts, yet true self-transformation must begin from within.
segments.en_text: Oh, you will be tangled up in it, which only makes things more troublesome. So everyone, this is very important; let us return to the main point and continue our discussion. Nowadays, plastic surgery is very popular; everyone only knows how to transform their outward appearance but doesn't know how to cultivate and adjust their hearts, yet true self-transformation must begin from within.

segments.text: 現代人。流行整形。手機裡面。在拍照當中，流行美肌。這個。像修圖，這個有一點點皺。拍美肌的照片起來，皺紋都不見了，所以說自己在看都覺得好像不像自己。目前就沒有那麼年輕。
segments.source_en: Modern people love plastic surgery, and in mobile photography, it's popular to use beauty filters—if you have a few wrinkles, a beauty filter makes them disappear. So sometimes, when looking at the photos, you feel like it doesn't even look like you.
segments.en_text: Modern people love plastic surgery, and in mobile photography, it's popular to use beauty filters—if you have a few wrinkles, a beauty filter makes them disappear. So sometimes, when looking at the photos, you feel like it doesn't even look like you.

segments.text: 說現代人流行整形。但是流行整形的結果。則是外表的改造。可是各位。要記得。相由心生。你現在的外在形象，只是你內心的顯現。所以你去整形的結果，只是整外在。可是內心不變。內心不變。你內心跟外在。
segments.source_en: You aren't actually that young. That is why plastic surgery is so popular among people today. However, the result of popular plastic surgery is only an outward transformation; but remember, everyone, "appearance stems from the heart. " Your current external image is just a manifestation of your inner state, so when you get plastic surgery, you only change the outside, but the inside remains the same.
segments.en_text: You aren't actually that young. That is why plastic surgery is so popular among people today. However, the result of popular plastic surgery is only an outward transformation; but remember, everyone, "appearance stems from the heart. " Your current external image is just a manifestation of your inner state, so when you get plastic surgery, you only change the outside, but the inside remains the same.

segments.text: 目前你沒有整形的時候，是相對應的結果。若只你外在整了。你內心沒調整。想像一下。這個不對頻的結果。那未來。這個閩南話講的叫走精了。這個反應反而更不好看。所以我們修道。我們不一定要去整形。我們拍照不一定要美肌。真實呈現。
segments.source_en: With the inside unchanged, your heart and your pre-surgery appearance correspond to one another as a complete result. But if you change the outside without adjusting your heart, the result is different. Imagine this mismatch—in Taiwanese, we call it "zhao jing," which actually ends up looking even worse. Therefore, in our practice, we don't necessarily need plastic surgery, and we don't need filters in our photos ; we should present ourselves truthfully.
segments.en_text: With the inside unchanged, your heart and your pre-surgery appearance correspond to one another as a complete result. But if you change the outside without adjusting your heart, the result is different. Imagine this mismatch—in Taiwanese, we call it "zhao jing," which actually ends up looking even worse. Therefore, in our practice, we don't necessarily need plastic surgery, and we don't need filters in our photos ; we should present ourselves truthfully.

segments.text: 但我們從內心裡面去改造。去調整。去修正。當從內心裡面去改造調整修正當中。你內心是非常美的。顯現了。你外在的顯現也自然是美的。你要不要試看看。
segments.source_en: Instead, we should transform ourselves from within. Adjust ourselves. Correct ourselves; when you transform, adjust, and correct from within, your inner self becomes truly beautiful, and your outward appearance will naturally be beautiful as well. Would you like to give it a try?
segments.en_text: Instead, we should transform ourselves from within. Adjust ourselves. Correct ourselves; when you transform, adjust, and correct from within, your inner self becomes truly beautiful, and your outward appearance will naturally be beautiful as well. Would you like to give it a try?

segments.text: 不用從外在去改，從內心去調整。修道修心就在告訴我們這個。我們再回到本文裡面來探討。為何路壞了要修。衣服破了要補。花為何會美？因為它不斷地修剪。人也是一樣。聖賢生活為何能成就？
segments.source_en: There is no need to change from the outside; start by adjusting from within. Cultivating to the level of the heart —that is what this tells us. Let us return to the fundamentals: if a road is damaged, it must be repaired; if clothes are torn, they must be mended. Why are flowers beautiful? Because they are constantly pruned. People are the same. Why are sages and Buddhas able to attain enlightenment?
segments.en_text: There is no need to change from the outside; start by adjusting from within. Cultivating to the level of the heart —that is what this tells us. Let us return to the fundamentals: if a road is damaged, it must be repaired; if clothes are torn, they must be mended. Why are flowers beautiful? Because they are constantly pruned. People are the same. Why are sages and Buddhas able to attain enlightenment?

segments.text: 因為他們不斷地改，不斷地修，修個心性。修道修心，就是一直修。路壞了要修，衣服破了要補。當然現在的社會經濟狀況很好。衣服還沒破可能就換了一件，它在以前，這個經濟不像現在這麼富足的年代，衣服破了要補啊。那花為什麼會美？
segments.source_en: Because they constantly change and constantly cultivate, dear fellow practitioners. Cultivating to the level of the heart means to keep cultivating. If a road is damaged, it must be repaired. If clothes are torn, they must be mended. Of course, in today's society. Economic conditions are good, so one might replace an item even before it is torn. But in the past, in an era not as affluent as today, if something was torn, it had to be mended.
segments.en_text: Because they constantly change and constantly cultivate, dear fellow practitioners. Cultivating to the level of the heart means to keep cultivating. If a road is damaged, it must be repaired. If clothes are torn, they must be mended. Of course, in today's society. Economic conditions are good, so one might replace an item even before it is torn. But in the past, in an era not as affluent as today, if something was torn, it had to be mended.

segments.text: 樹為什麼會美？因為它是透過不斷的修剪當中。當然。路壞了要修。衣服破了要補。花要不斷的修剪，人也是如此。啊，聖賢生活，為什麼他們能夠成就？因為他們不斷的改。
segments.source_en: So why are flowers beautiful? Why are trees beautiful? Because they go through constant pruning. Of course, if a road is damaged, it must be repaired. If clothes are torn, they must be mended; if flowers need constant pruning, people are the same. Why are sages and Buddhas able to attain enlightenment?
segments.en_text: So why are flowers beautiful? Why are trees beautiful? Because they go through constant pruning. Of course, if a road is damaged, it must be repaired. If clothes are torn, they must be mended; if flowers need constant pruning, people are the same. Why are sages and Buddhas able to attain enlightenment?

segments.text: 不斷的修，箇中竅門。剛剛仙佛告訴我們，我們修道的保險單。讓你因為你透過修道當中，有這些保險單的保障。再透過你不斷的修。我們自然可以跟仙佛一樣，有所成就。不要搞錯方向。不用在外在調整。因為畢竟外在是你內心的顯現。你剛調整外在，內心沒有調整。
segments.source_en: Because they constantly change and constantly cultivate, moving forward. The Buddhas just told us about the insurance policy of our cultivation; by going through cultivation, you have the protection of these insurance policies, and through your constant practice, we can naturally achieve success just like the Buddhas. Do not head in the wrong direction; there is no need to adjust the exterior, because the exterior is, after all, a manifestation of your inner self.
segments.en_text: Because they constantly change and constantly cultivate, moving forward. The Buddhas just told us about the insurance policy of our cultivation; by going through cultivation, you have the protection of these insurance policies, and through your constant practice, we can naturally achieve success just like the Buddhas. Do not head in the wrong direction; there is no need to adjust the exterior, because the exterior is, after all, a manifestation of your inner self.

segments.text: 以後不對盤、不對稱，反而看起來不自然，有沒有？我們看到有一些整形過了以後，經過一段時間，看起來就不自然。為什麼？因為跟內心裡面不對稱了嘛。所以各位先生，從內心著手，學習像仙佛一樣，不斷的修。
segments.source_en: If you adjust the exterior without adjusting your heart, things will be asymmetrical and look unnatural , right? We see some people who, after undergoing plastic surgery, look unnatural after a period of time. Why? Because it is not in symmetry with their inner self. Therefore, fellow practitioners, start from within.
segments.en_text: If you adjust the exterior without adjusting your heart, things will be asymmetrical and look unnatural , right? We see some people who, after undergoing plastic surgery, look unnatural after a period of time. Why? Because it is not in symmetry with their inner self. Therefore, fellow practitioners, start from within.

segments.text: 不斷的改，自然你能夠成就。我們再回到本裡面來探討。所謂修者改也。氣柔了、順了，事業才會順，此點非常重要。要快樂、健康、幸福，一定要從根本處著手。
segments.source_en: Learn from the Buddhas to constantly cultivate and change; naturally, you will succeed. Let us return to the fundamentals: to cultivate is to change . When your energy (Qi) is soft and smooth, your career will be smooth. This point is crucial. For happiness and health, one must start from the root.
segments.en_text: Learn from the Buddhas to constantly cultivate and change; naturally, you will succeed. Let us return to the fundamentals: to cultivate is to change . When your energy (Qi) is soft and smooth, your career will be smooth. This point is crucial. For happiness and health, one must start from the root.

segments.text: 隔一千年。什麼叫修。修就是改啊。修就是把多的東西把它去除啊。你只要有修、有改。你的氣會柔。會順。氣柔順了。你的事業才會順。
segments.source_en: Fellow practitioners, what is cultivation? Cultivation is change. Cultivation is removing the unnecessary parts of yourself. As long as you cultivate and change, your energy will become soft and smooth. Once it is smooth, your career will naturally be smooth.
segments.en_text: Fellow practitioners, what is cultivation? Cultivation is change. Cultivation is removing the unnecessary parts of yourself. As long as you cultivate and change, your energy will become soft and smooth. Once it is smooth, your career will naturally be smooth.

segments.text: 所以有時候你會覺得人好像不順遂，不順遂先檢討一下你的氣有沒有柔呢。若有，自然磁場會變。自然你就會快樂、會健康、會幸福。所以仙佛慈悲告訴我們。
segments.source_en: So, sometimes when you feel things are not going well or are frustrating, first examine whether your energy is soft and smooth. If it is, your magnetic field will naturally change. Naturally, you will be healthy and happy. Therefore, the Buddhas compassionately tell us: cultivation is change. Starting from this root is the right way.
segments.en_text: So, sometimes when you feel things are not going well or are frustrating, first examine whether your energy is soft and smooth. If it is, your magnetic field will naturally change. Naturally, you will be healthy and happy. Therefore, the Buddhas compassionately tell us: cultivation is change. Starting from this root is the right way.

segments.text: 修就是改。就是從這個根本處著手就對了。祝福你。
segments.source_en: Blessings to you.
segments.en_text: Blessings to you.
